intended_use.summary: Acquire the smallest exact public USGS road, selected public-facility, and BLM-boundary GeoJSON query responses around the bounded Ward Creek integration geography; reuse the exact already-governed Ward Creek MTBS boundary; then create attributed, deterministic, non-operational context overlays and descriptive measurements.
planned_actions: acquire exact public GeoJSON query responses
retain exact responses in ignored repository-local custody
use the exact local MTBS boundary as official reference context
